headline: Dell (DELL) Chosen To Build Texas A&M’s IGNITE AI Research Platform
summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) has been selected by the Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station to build IGNITE, a secure AI and high performance computing platform. IGNITE is designed to support advanced academic research with shared infrastructure and extensive security capabilities. The deployment is described as one of the largest academic AI platforms in the US, aimed at serving a wide range of research disciplines.
